summary.headline: The Master Plan Implementation Committee prepared recommendations urging the Planning Board to lead the upcoming Master Plan 2030 process.
summary.summary: The Master Plan Implementation Committee met to debrief a recent Planning Board discussion and plan for a joint presentation on October 19, 2026. Members reviewed research on how neighboring towns conduct master planning, including estimated consultant costs of $50,000 to $60,000. The committee emphasized that the Planning Board should take ownership of initiating and managing the next master plan rather than assigning that role to the implementation committee. The committee also approved previous meeting minutes.

topics.title: Master Plan 2030 planning and presentation to Planning Board
topics.summary: The committee discussed its upcoming presentation to the Planning Board regarding preparations for the town's next comprehensive master plan. Members reviewed comparative research on how neighboring towns like Westborough and Northborough structured their master plans, noting typical consultant costs range between $40,000 and $70,000 (averaging around $50,000 to $60,000). The committee agreed to recommend that the Planning Board take ownership of the process and establish a dedicated Master Plan 2030 committee in 2027, with the implementation committee serving in an advisory capacity. They also discussed improving progress metrics for ongoing master plan goals using status indicators rather than strict percentage completions.
key_details: MPIC will present to the Planning Board at their meeting on October 19, 2026.
Committee recommends the Planning Board establish a Master Plan 2030 committee in 2027.
Neighboring municipal master planning consultant costs were estimated around $50,000 to $60,000.
A committee member compiled desktop comparative research and a 20-question outreach guide for other towns.
Members recommended shifting ongoing goal tracking from percentage completion to on-track or falling-short status indicators.
topics.outcome: The chair will compile presentation slides and comparative research documents to send to the Planning Board and post a joint meeting notice for October 19, 2026.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The committee reviewed and approved meeting minutes and briefly checked member updates.
key_details: Minutes of September 10, 2026 were approved with a spelling correction to Superintendent Martineau's name.
No additional member updates were reported.
